segments.name: Final Control
segments.description: Provides valves, actuators and regulators that control and regulate the flow of liquids or gases for process and hybrid industry manufacturers.
segments.evidence: The Final Control segment is a leading global provider of control valves, isolation valves, shutoff valves, pressure relief valves, pressure safety valves, actuators, and regulators for process and hybrid industries.

segments.name: Measurement & Analytical
segments.description: Supplies intelligent instrumentation measuring physical properties of liquids or gases for process and hybrid industry operators.
segments.evidence: The Measurement & Analytical segment is a leading supplier of intelligent instrumentation measuring the physical properties of liquids or gases, such as pressure, temperature, level, flow, acoustics, corrosion, pH, conductivity, water quality, toxic gases, and flame.

segments.name: Discrete Automation
products: programmable automation control systems and software
segments.description: Provides valves, actuators, motion and control solutions used primarily in discrete industries.
segments.evidence: The Discrete Automation segment includes solenoid valves, pneumatic valves, valve position indicators, pneumatic cylinders and actuators, air preparation equipment, pressure and temperature switches, electric linear motion solutions, programmable automation control systems and software, electrical distribution equipment, and materials joining solutions used primarily in discrete industries.

segments.name: Safety & Productivity
segments.description: Delivers tools for professionals and homeowners that support infrastructure, promote safety and enhance productivity.
segments.evidence: The Safety & Productivity segment delivers tools for professionals and homeowners that support infrastructure, promote safety and enhance productivity.

segments.name: Control Systems & Software
segments.description: Provides control systems and asset optimization software, including AspenTech, used predominantly by process and hybrid manufacturers.
segments.evidence: The Control Systems & Software segment provides control systems and software that control plant processes by collecting and analyzing information from measurement devices in the plant.

segments.name: Test & Measurement
segments.description: Provides software-connected automated test and measurement systems that help enterprises bring products to market faster and at lower cost.
segments.evidence: Test & Measurement provides software-connected automated test and measurement systems that enable enterprises to bring products to market faster and at a lower cost.

changes.text: In 2025, AspenTech, previously a separate segment, was consolidated into the Control Systems & Software segment after Emerson purchased the remaining outstanding shares.
changes.evidence: AspenTech's results, which were previously reported as a separate segment, are now consolidated into the Control Systems & Software segment for all periods presented.

changes.text: In 2023, Emerson sold a majority stake in its Climate Technologies business (Copeland), constituting the former Climate Technologies segment, and fully exited the interest in 2024.
changes.evidence: On May 31, 2023, the Company completed the sale of a majority stake in its Climate Technologies business (which constitutes the former Climate Technologies segment, excluding Therm-O-Disc which was divested earlier in 2022; the new standalone business is named Copeland) to private equity funds managed by Blackstone in a $14.0 billion transaction.

changes.text: In 2023, the acquired National Instruments business began being reported as the new Test & Measurement segment.
changes.evidence: On October 11, 2023, the Company completed the acquisition of National Instruments Corporation ("NI") at an equity value of $8.2 billion.
